citations.excerpt: The call which resulted in the first expedition for the recovery of Jerusalem was made by Pope Urban II. at the Council of Clermont, 1095.
The culmination of the First Crusade was the fall of Jerusalem, July 15, 1099.

facts.value: Military expedition called by Pope Urban II at Clermont that ended with the capture of Jerusalem.
